newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-STRIKER, 13, DENIED RUSSIAN CUP GLORY GOAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRIKER, 13, DENIED RUSSIAN CUP GLORY GOAL.

text.p: Thirteen-year-old Dmitry Kudryashov was denied a place in soccer history this week when he scored a last minute equaliser in a Russian Cup match -- only to see his effort disallowed.

Kudryashov, the youngest player in the Russian League, was sent on as a late substitute with his second division team Zenit Izhevsk trailing 1-0 to third division Elektron Vyatskiye in the first round Cup clash.
But his 90th minute goal was ruled out, leading Zenit president Valery Ivanov to say on Friday he believed the referee simply wanted to avoid extra time.
Kudryashov was bitterly disappointed but he can console himself with a trip to Italy next week with Russia's under-15 international squad.
